ante_bet.effects: Xtra-Bet™ raises Base Bet by 100% (total cost 2× bet). Wins are evaluated on the Base Bet amount, not the Xtra-Bet amount. Cannot be combined with Fast Track™. Increases the chance of triggering the Free Spins bonus (exact chance multiplier not captured for this title).
